scenes.vo: Pistachio double mehnga kyun? Aur 9 khabrein jo jeb chhooti hain.
Ek: GST 5 percent hua, to tyohaar mein dry fruit, chocolate zyada aaye.
Do: Pistachio lagbhag double mehnga hua, West Asia tanaav aur kam fasal se.
Teen: Bagmane office building company ne niveshkon ko kiraye ka paisa baanta.
Chaar: Crude mehnga hone se mehngai badhne ka dar hai, EY ke mutabik.
Paanch: RBI ghar-ghar poochh raha hai, aapko mehngai kitni lagti hai.
Chhe: Office waali naukriyon ki hiring badhi, sabse zyada manufacturing mein.
Saat: Mutual funds ne chhote companies ke share becha, kuch share kaafi gire.
Aath: BLS Polymers ka share listing par IPO bhav se kaafi upar khula.
Nau: AdaniConneX reportedly data centre ke liye videshi banks se udhaar maang raha.
Das: Gold ETF mein paisa ghata, Sebi ke kehne par kuch fund band.
Yeh investment advice nahi hai. Us dost ko bhejo jo IPO ke peeche bhaagta hai.
